members.name: Chriscia Xanelle Llamas
members.bio: Chriscia leads the guild: she sets the direction for the year, chairs the Executive Committee, and answers for everything UPCSG puts its name on.

members.name: Diane Bustamante
members.quote: Start where you are, with what you have.
members.bio: Diane works alongside the Executive Director to keep the committees moving, and steps in wherever a project needs a second pair of hands.

members.name: Irish Francisco
members.quote: If it wasn't written down, it didn't happen.
members.bio: Irish keeps the guild's records: minutes of every meeting, the membership roll, and the correspondence that goes out under the org's name.

members.name: Niño Gian Pelenio
members.quote: Every peso has a paper trail.
members.bio: Nino handles the guild's funds - budgets for each event, collections for merch and dues, and the financial report the org answers to.

members.name: Tiffany Lalata
members.bio: Tiffany reviews the books independently of the Treasurer, checking that disbursements match what was approved and that the records hold up.

members.name: Emman Esperanza
members.quote: Good work deserves to be seen.
members.bio: Emman runs the guild's promotion: campaigns for events and merch drops, and making sure the things guilders build actually reach an audience.

members.name: Jasmine Monteroso
members.quote: Make it clear first. Then make it beautiful.
members.bio: Jasmine owns the guild's visual identity - publication materials, event branding, and the look of everything UPCSG publishes.

members.name: Sylvia Staheli
members.bio: Sylvia builds the guild's relationships outside the org: sponsors, partner organizations, and the industry contacts behind our talks and events.

members.name: June Abadia
members.quote: Teach the thing you struggled with.
members.bio: June runs the academic side of the guild - tutorials, workshops, and the study sessions that run every week rather than only before finals.

members.name: Erik James M. Caliskis
members.quote: The venue, the schedule, and the group chat.
members.bio: Erik keeps events standing up: booking, equipment, timelines, and the internal communication that gets everyone to the right place.

members.name: Suzzane Tan
members.quote: Bring it up. That's what I'm here for.
members.bio: Suzzane represents UPCSG in the SRP, carrying guilder concerns into wider student representation and bringing decisions back to the org.

events.title: Start of Classes
events.description: For Academic Year 2026–2027, the first semester at the University of the Philippines Cebu officially starts on August 10, 2026, with registration wrapping up by August 12. The semester runs until December 10, 2026.

events.title: UPCSG General Assembly
events.description: The UP Cebu Student Government (UPCSG or UPC USC) general assembly serves as the supreme deliberative gathering of the student body, uniting students to review council accomplishments, debate pressing academic and national policies, and vote on progressive student-led resolutions and welfare initiatives.

achievements.title: UP Cebu CS Students Clinch Top Spots in Regional Esports Game Dev Challenge
achievements.description:
Second-year Computer Science students from UP Cebu earned top finishes at the NEXT LEVEL: Esports Game Dev Challenge.

Second-year Computer Science students from UP Cebu earned top finishes at the NEXT LEVEL: Esports Game Dev Challenge, with Team <blank> claiming first runner-up and Team Casa de Kirby finishing in the top ten during the 2026 Regional Science, Technology, and Innovation Week celebration organized by DOST Central Visayas held on July 13-15, 2026, at Waterfront Cebu City Hotel.
Team <blank> developed the game SARAP!, a Filipino cooking game where players prepare nearly forgotten regional dishes. The team is composed of Tyrone Gareth Cular, Krysta Belle Amojedo, Alynnah Rhein Cahutay, and Clandestine Maglasang, mentored by Ms. J Isle Rocamora.
Another finalist, Team Casa de Kirby, created Rescue Rush, a speedrun game where players save civilians scattered around a flooded village as fast as they can. The team is composed of Resha Alpuerto, Angelo Luize Ramirez, Sam Joash Recodo, Joy Montilde, and John Kirby Monleon, under the mentorship of Mr. Eli Edrian Tan.
